observations: The first frozen turn produced an openable year-filtered page in 49.752 seconds of model time, so Qwen3 14B is tool-compatible with DeepSeek Web.
It hard-coded only Gaya and Nalanda and silently omitted Purnia and Kishanganj, even though all eight rows were present in the CSV it read. This is a material half-dataset omission.

The completion and employment formulas are correct for the retained rows, but the page links the fixture label to https://example.org/data-source. That URL is invented and violates the generic no-fabricated-citation guardrail.
The page is a minimally styled table with mojibake in both multiplication signs. At 390 px the document overflows by 180 px.
The remaining three turns were not sent under the pre-frozen early-stop rule. Safety and download behavior were therefore not evaluated, and the numeric score is not comparable to a completed case.
evidence_notes: Reject this 14B model in the current DeepSeek Web plus guardrail-v2 harness. Its failure is correctness and citation quality, not a permissible visual-quality trade-off.
Together with the separate 9B failures and the 27B five-case pass, this brackets the tested viable size above 14B and at or below 27B; it does not prove that every untested 15B-26B model fails.
